verdict: FTSE 100 shares, 2026-08-24 to 2026-10-29 (48 trading days), 377 completed trades under the live rules; split at 2026-09-28 into an earlier and a later half.

Chance test: the scanner made £-51.66. The same trades in a random direction averaged £-44.20; 72% of random versions did as well. At a random time the same day they averaged £-40.45; 86% did as well.
The scanner does not clearly beat chance: filters cannot create an edge that is not there, so the improvement has to come from the entry signal itself or from the exits.
B0. + breakout still past the zone by 0 typical candle ranges: did not help (average per trade £-0.15 v £-0.14; 356 trades)
B1. + breakout still past the zone by 0.1 typical candle ranges: helped in one half only (average per trade £-0.15 v £-0.14; 353 trades)
B2. + breakout still past the zone by 0.25 typical candle ranges: did not help (average per trade £-0.17 v £-0.14; 343 trades)
B3. + breakout still past the zone by 0.5 typical candle ranges: did not help (average per trade £-0.18 v £-0.14; 326 trades)
C. + at least 75% of the planned stop room left: helped in one half only (average per trade £-0.16 v £-0.14; 316 trades)
D. + stop not already traded through that day: helped in both halves (average per trade £-0.06 v £-0.14; 84 trades)
E. + no trades in a sideways regime: helped in both halves (average per trade £-0.13 v £-0.14; 381 trades)
F. + zone at least 2 trading hours old: did not help (average per trade £-0.14 v £-0.14; 377 trades)
Self-search found and confirmed: Only trades where zone age (trading minutes) is 4.25e+03 to 7.65e+03 (gain £+25.21 on the first half, £+17.24 on the unseen second half).
Self-search found and confirmed: Only trades where fill v 9 EMA in trade's direction (%) is under 0.14 (gain £+24.74 on the first half, £+22.27 on the unseen second half).
Self-search found and confirmed: Skip trades where stop already traded through is Yes (gain £+24.01 on the first half, £+31.30 on the unseen second half).
Self-search found and confirmed: Only trades where weekday is Thursday (gain £+22.32 on the first half, £+22.31 on the unseen second half).
Self-search found and confirmed: Only trades where signal volume v normal is under 0.3 (gain £+21.36 on the first half, £+27.06 on the unseen second half).
Self-search found and confirmed: Only trades where opening gap in trade's direction (%) is -0.23 to 0.27 (gain £+21.25 on the first half, £+23.13 on the unseen second half).
Exits: best was 'Half the target' with £-27.25 v £-51.66 for the current exit (not better in both halves).
All results are paper research on about 60 days of one market period. Nothing changes live trading without Phil's agreement.
